notes: Google Photos albums now load past ~30 photos, with sharper full-resolution portraits and a blurred letterbox backdrop. The photo frame shows over a screen-lock PIN on motion wake (tap still asks for the PIN). A dropped phone-remote connection no longer crashes the launcher. Home-icon dragging is now transactional - no more scrambled layouts from a stray gesture. Adds an Android Recents button beside the QuickBar navigation, and Calls handoff now uses the stock-launcher deep link.
